comment: Jon arrived on time and explained the problems he found with my lawn irrigation system. We talked about options for repairs and he completed everything in a timely manner. He was very courteous and answered all my questions. Very happy with this service.
draft_response: So glad to hear the lawn care turned out well for you, Janet. We love serving the Fort Worth community, and it's always good to know the crew made the experience a smooth one. Black Hill Landscaping is here whenever you need us.
